summary_en: Penta-Ocean Construction authorized the acquisition of up to 5.0 million shares (1.9% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 10, 2026 to January 31, 2027, aimed at strengthening management foundation, enhancing shareholder returns, and improving capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, Penta-Ocean Construction's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 5.0 million treasury shares, representing 1.9% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum outlay of 5.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 10, 2026 to January 31, 2027. No price ceiling per share was specified in the disclosure.

The company stated three purposes for the buyback: strengthening its management foundation in preparation for the future through capital enhancement; increasing profitability and corporate value through growth investments in technology development and capital expenditure; and enhancing shareholder returns through continuous and stable dividends combined with treasury share acquisitions. The company also emphasized improved capital efficiency as an objective.
